evidence.quote: Unpack and check the delivery. If damage is found, notify the supplier.
Tighten the screws to 0.5 - 1.0 Nm.

review_note: The X2 pro 10 B2 manual contains the identical 8-step process with the same wording (the X2 pro 15 B2 manual differs slightly in the torque line), so the retriever may cite a sibling manual; the cut-out size (130 x 89 mm, from p14) is specific to the X2 pro 4.
